convert_se3_log_to_matrix: convert a batch of 6D SE(3) log vectors to 4x4 transformation matrices using se3_exp_map
convert_se3_matrix_to_log: convert a batch of 4x4 SE(3) transformation matrices to 6D log vectors using se3_log_map
compute_se3_V_matrix: compute the SE(3) V matrix from rotation angles and hat operators using _se3_V_matrix
compute_se3_V_inputs: compute the input variables for the SE(3) V matrix from a log rotation vector using _get_se3_V_input
review_se3_transforms: review the se3_exp_map and se3_log_map functions for SE(3) exponential and logarithmic map conversions
